none: PAS FindID 997192: Lin-77CEFE: Roman nummus of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman, copper alloy nummus, House of Constantine, Gloria exercitus, 335-337. Heavily worn. Obverse description: right facing bust with diadem, draped and cuirassed. Obverse inscription: [PLI]VL CONSTAN[S N]OB [C]AES]. Reverse description: two soldiers holding one standard. Reverse inscription: [GLO]R-[IA EXERC-ITVS]. Diameter: 12.76 mm; Thickness: 1.40 mm; Weight: 0.52g
